title: AL-Go action repro manifest
description: Describes a single isolated invocation of an AL-Go action, reconstructed from a bug report. Produced by the issue-triage agent or written by hand, and consumed by Tests/Repro/Invoke-ActionRepro.ps1.

action.description: Name of the action folder under Actions/, for example 'CalculateArtifactNames'. Must be a plain folder name with no path separators.

parameters.description: Parameters passed to the action script. AL-Go action parameters are always String, Int32 or Boolean.

script.description: Optional entry script file name within the action folder. Only needed when the action has several candidate scripts and none is named <action>.ps1 or <action>.Action.ps1.

settings.description: AL-Go settings made available to the action as the Settings environment variable (compressed JSON).

secrets.description: Placeholder secret values made available as the Secrets environment variable. Use fake values only. Every value is masked in the result.

env.description: Additional environment variables, typically GITHUB_* values such as GITHUB_REF_NAME or GITHUB_EVENT_NAME.

files.description: Files to seed into the scratch workspace before the action runs. Keys are workspace-relative paths, values are file contents.

issue.description: Issue number this repro was reconstructed from, for traceability.

reported.description: The behaviour the reporter observed, in their words.

notes.description: Any assumptions made while reconstructing the manifest, especially values that were guessed rather than stated in the issue.
